## JOIN THE CAMPAIGN
## ELECT SHERRY HU
Our quality of life depends on a safe community in our homes, schools, and local businesses. I advocate for a proactive approach AND zero tolerance for violent crime.
ABOUT SHERRY
donate
#### Safe. Strong. Sustainable.
Dublin has been ranked the No. 1 Best Place to Live in California for 2026 to 2027 by U.S. News & World Report. This recognition reflects the strength of our community and the exceptional quality of life we have built together.
During my current two-year term as Mayor, we have strengthened public safety, opened three new parks, welcomed more than 100 new businesses, supported our schools and students, invested in roads and infrastructure, expanded community programs, and maintained strong city finances.
Over the next two-year term, I will build on this progress, protect what makes Dublin special, and prepare our city responsibly for the future.
#### Keeping Dublin Safe
Public safety will remain my highest priority.
I will continue supporting our police officers, firefighters, emergency personnel, school resource officers, and behavioral health resources. We will strengthen community partnerships, use modern technology, and support proactive policing to prevent crime and respond quickly to emergencies.
Every Dublin resident deserves to feel safe at home, at school, in our parks, and throughout our community. I will continue working to keep Dublin one of California’s safest and most welcoming cities.
#### Investing in Parks, Families, and Quality of Life
Our parks, recreation programs, cultural events, and community spaces help make Dublin a wonderful place to call home.
During the past two years, Dublin opened Wallis Ranch Community Park, Forest Park, and Phase 1 of Iron Horse Nature Park and Open Space. These new parks provide more places for recreation, exercise, nature, and community gatherings.
I will continue investing in well-maintained parks, youth and senior programs, arts and cultural activities, sports facilities, trails, and welcoming public spaces that bring our community together.
#### Supporting Businesses and Local Jobs
A thriving business community creates jobs, strengthens our tax base, and helps fund essential city services.
Dublin has welcomed more than 100 new businesses, including Grocery Outlet, H Mart, Dish N Dash, Bódrum Mezze & Cocktails, Inchin’s Bamboo Garden, BB.Q Chicken, and many other restaurants, retailers, healthcare providers, and entertainment destinations.
I will continue supporting local businesses, attracting high-quality employers, improving the permitting process, revitalizing commercial areas, and advancing the Fallon East Economic Development Zone. Dublin should remain a place where businesses and entrepreneurs can succeed.
#### Planning for Sustainable Growth
Dublin’s future requires thoughtful planning, reliable infrastructure, and balanced growth.
I will continue advancing transportation and roadway improvements, including the reconstruction of Village Parkway, improvements along Tassajara Road, annual street resurfacing, and safer connections for pedestrians and bicyclists.
As Dublin grows, our roads, public safety services, schools, parks, and infrastructure must keep pace. I will support responsible development that meets our community’s needs while protecting the quality of life that earned Dublin recognition as California’s best place to live.
#### Protecting Dublin’s Financial Strength
Strong finances allow Dublin to provide excellent services, invest in infrastructure, and prepare responsibly for the future.
While many cities are struggling to balance their budgets, Dublin ended the fiscal year 2025 with a General Fund surplus of approximately $35 million, reflecting strong and responsible financial management.
With my professional background in finance, engineering, and project management, I carefully examine how public funds are spent. I will continue maintaining healthy reserves, planning for long-term costs, investing in essential services, and ensuring that our financial decisions remain transparent and responsible.
#### Supporting Students and Schools
Item descriptionExcellent schools and safe learning environments are central to Dublin’s future.
Our community celebrated the opening of the new Emerald High School campus in 2024, and Shamrock Hills TK-8 School opened its doors to students in fall 2026. The City has supported school planning, crossing guards, Safe Routes to School, school resource officers, emergency preparedness, drug prevention education, and youth programs.
I will continue building a strong partnership between the City and Dublin Unified School District to support student safety, learning, leadership, and success.
#### Moving Dublin Forward Together
Dublin’s success belongs to all of us. It comes from engaged residents, dedicated city employees, excellent schools, thriving businesses, community organizations, and neighbors who care for one another.
It is a great honor to serve as your Mayor. Together, we can build on the progress of the past two years and keep Dublin safe, strong, sustainable, and an exceptional place to call home.

ENDORSEMENTS

images.heading: David Haubert
images.nearby: David Haubert “ Dublin’s ranking as California’s number one best place to live reflects the strength of our community. Mayor Sherry Hu has delivered results, and I support her continued leadership. ” — President David Haubert President, Alameda County Board of Supervisors, District 1

images.heading: Melissa Hernandez
images.nearby: Melissa Hernandez “ Having worked alongside Sherry, I have seen firsthand her genuine heart for Dublin. She listens to residents, supports families, and works hard to keep our community safe, welcoming, and strong. ” — Former Mayor Melissa Hernandez Former Mayor of Dublin, Candidate for U.S. Congress CA-14, BART Board of Directors D5

images.heading: Nate Miley
images.nearby: Nate Miley “ Sherry is a hands-on leader who shows up for her community. She is committed to public safety, local businesses, and responsive government. ” — Supervisor Nate Miley Alameda County Supervisor, District 4

images.heading: Lena Tam
images.nearby: Lena Tam “ Sherry serves with compassion and genuinely cares about families, youth, seniors, and people from every background. Dublin is fortunate to have her leadership. ” — Supervisor Lena Tam Vice President, Alameda County Board of Supervisors, District 3

images.heading: John Marchand
images.nearby: John Marchand “ I have worked alongside Sherry on regional priorities and advocacy for the Tri-Valley. She is a strong regional partner who understands the importance of collaboration, safe communities, and a thriving local economy. ” — Mayor John Marchand Mayor of Livermore

images.heading: Fiona Ma
images.nearby: Fiona Ma “ I endorse Dr. Sherry Hu for mayor of Dublin because of her proven track record — whether it’s getting things done, digging into finances, leading community cleanups, supporting families, opening new businesses, or enhancing public safety. ” — State Treasurer Fiona Ma CA State Treasurer

images.heading: Michael Goldstein
images.nearby: Michael Goldstein “ As a long-term volunteer, I deeply appreciate Sherry’s unwavering dedication to our community, her kindness, and her genuine desire to give back. ” — DLC President Michael Goldstein President of Dublin Lions Club and St. Patrick Day Parade Host

images.heading: Michael Karami
images.nearby: Michael Karami “ Sherry has been a vital supporter of the Race Amity event, championing interracial friendship and equality to strengthen our community. ” — RADF Organizer Michael Karami Race Amity Day Festival Organizer and Long-time Dublin Resident

images.heading: Pradeep Routra
images.nearby: Pradeep Routra “ Sherry is dedicated to supporting community needs, especially youth and families, and is always accessible and personable in her approach. ” — Head Coach Pradeep Routra DHS Cricket Head Coach and DSCA Founder

images.heading: Zaheer Siddiqui
images.nearby: Zaheer Siddiqui “ Sherry truly cares about our community and goes above and beyond to address our needs. She is deeply respectful of diversity, honoring different cultures and religions. Sherry stands strong for every community member, and I trust her to be the leader we need for our diverse Tri-Valley area. ” — Founder Zaheer Siddiqui Founder, MCC East Bay

images.heading: CC Yin
images.nearby: CC Yin “ We are proud to endorse Sherry for her outstanding leadership, dedication to service, and the inspiration she provides as a role model. ” — APAPA Founder CC Yin APAPA Founder

images.heading: Jack Ding
images.nearby: Jack Ding “ Dr. Sherry Hu’s proven leadership in advanced technology, her experience with Fortune 500 companies and startups, and her commitment to the next generation make her the visionary leader Dublin needs for a brighter future. ” — Former Mayor Jack Ding Councilmember, Former Mayor of Sonoma

images.heading: Kansen Chu
images.nearby: Kansen Chu “ I’ve known Sherry for a long time and believe she’s the best candidate for Dublin—she has integrity, the right qualifications, and a true heart to serve. ” — Former Assembly Kansen Chu Former CA State Assembly

images.heading: Carmen Montano
images.nearby: Carmen Montano “ I support Sherry because she will keep Dublin safe and economically strong. ” — Mayor Carmen Montano Milpitas Mayor

images.heading: Tony Spitaleri
images.nearby: Tony Spitaleri “ As a mayor, Sherry Hu of Dublin has proven herself to be an effective leader. Sherry has served on several boards and commissions. Her commitment to public safety, schools, and businesses will ensure the diverse community of Dublin will continue to be a city where citizens want to live, work, and enjoy the services along with activities the city provides. Vote a proven leader vote for Sherry Hu for Mayor of Dublin. ” — Former Mayor Tony Spitaleri Former Mayor of Sunnyvale

images.heading: Andy Li
images.nearby: Andy Li “ Sherry is a respected API community leader who mentors youth, supports emerging leaders, and advocates for Asian American communities. Her leadership helped bring thousands together for the 2021 rally against Asian hate. ” — CL President Andy Li Trustee, Contra Costa Community College District, Ward 4 President, Civic Leadership USA President, API Coalition

images.heading: Yang Shao
images.nearby: Yang Shao “ Sherry is an outstanding leader and has done so much for the well-being of our community and truly deserves our support. I sincerely urge everyone to unite and support her. ” — Councilmember Yang Shao City Councilmember of Fremont, District 4
